phaseAuthority.rule: phase(version) is read from versionToPhase only; it is monotonic (a later version never maps to an earlier phase); --release refuses a version whose phase is lower than the phase of the last published version (phase rollback)
phaseAuthority.applicability: cumulative: at phase p the gate blocks on every row stage with phase <= p and on every requirement probe of a requirement with blockingFrom <= p, plus the probes of each requirement gap whose blockingFrom <= p
phaseAuthority.dependencyRule: a row or stage may depend only on rows/stages whose phase is <= its own (validated by --check)
